title: Spawn the foreground launcher as a hidden, job-object-supervised child and record the receipt
outcome:
Command builder producing [node, scripts/test-launcher.mjs, preset, ...args] with cwd = root, CREATE_NO_WINDOW/setsid, TerminalProcessTree attach/resume (src/terminal.rs 657-694); read stdout until the receipt (run dir, manifest, expected fingerprint - tm-uex8.12), then detach from the pipes; store pid/run_dir/fingerprint; spawn a reaper thread (pattern: reap_engram_doctor_in_background) that finalizes from results.json on exit.

REVIEW FIXES (F1, F3, F6, F9, F13): drain stdout/stderr to EOF with bounded capture (bounded_read_process.rs:46-110 template), parse the receipt from the stream, host run_id at spawn with state starting, dedicated job without kill-on-close (Windows) / setsid (Unix), CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_SUSPENDED then attach+resume, env TERMAL_SESSION_ID=<requester>, reaper thread finalizes once from results.json (serialized with boot reconciliation). Fixture: src/tests/fixtures/test-launcher-receipt-fixture.mjs (+ long-stdout variant).

OUTPUT TO FILE (Greg, 2026-09-23): spawn with stdout+stderr redirected to the host-owned HOST_LOG file (opened before spawn, append mode, no pipes; stdin null); read the receipt by tailing HOST_LOG with a bounded wait (parse the one-line receipt from tm-uex8.12); after exit read the final summary from HOST_LOG; store host_log_path on the record. Delete the drain/reader-thread design; keep CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_SUSPENDED + named non-kill-on-close job + attach + resume, env TERMAL_SESSION_ID, reaper finalizing once from results.json.
acceptance:
- Receipt read from HOST_LOG within a bounded time; run_id returned before, run_dir/fingerprint after the receipt.
- No pipe handles are created for the child (builder struct asserts Stdio::from(file) for stdout/stderr and null stdin).
- Long final stdout (> 64 KiB) lands in HOST_LOG completely; the record finalizes once.
- Creation flags asserted on the builder struct; no console window on Windows (GetConsoleWindow() == 0 in the fixture).
